title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon narrows gap but doesn't overtake rivals
dek: New Gemini frontier model matches OpenAI on some tests but trails Anthropic while using far more tokens per task.
body:
Google released Gemini 4 Argon, its first “frontier” model in more than seven months. Independent testing shows Argon matches OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on the tests referenced, but it does not outperform Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5. Access is limited: select testers get the model first, with an API and paid tiers coming later.

## Why it matters

Gemini 4 Argon is a major step in Google’s model roadmap because it brings the company closer to parity with OpenAI on independent evaluations. That narrows a competitive gap that matters for enterprises and developers choosing among frontier models. However, Argon’s efficiency trade-offs , it consumes more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra — complicate comparisons based on headline per-token pricing alone.

## The details

- Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s first frontier model release in over seven months.
- Independent testing reported that Argon matches OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra on the referenced evaluations.
- Argon does not keep up with Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 in those same evaluations.
- Google’s per-token price for Argon is described as low, but Argon consumes more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra, which affects cost per task.
- Access is staged: select testers receive Argon first; the API and paid tiers will be available later.
- The specific benchmarks used in the independent testing, the exact cost comparisons per task, and the timing for a broader public rollout are not provided in the reporting.

## What to watch

Watch for independent benchmark disclosures that specify which tests were used and how Argon performs across objective measures such as reasoning, coding, and safety. Also track the timing and pricing details for the API and paid tiers, plus comparative per-task costing once token consumption and pricing are both known.

Source: [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/google-gemini-4-argon-closes-the-gap-with-openai-and-anthropic-but-doesnt-take-a-clear-lead/)
